beforeImage.name: Northstar New Jersey Lottery Group
beforeImage.description: Northstar New Jersey Lottery Group holds the long-term contract to manage marketing and sales operations for the New Jersey Lottery. Its customers or end markets include the State of New Jersey through the lottery concession framework and retail lottery distribution channels. The operating model is a concession-based operating model rather than ownership of utility-style hard assets. Operations are concentrated in New Jersey. Public materials indicate a contract structure originally awarded for 15 years and extended through June 2029 according to public disclosures. Current ownership was publicly disclosed at award as a consortium including Brightstar, Scientific Games, and an OMERS affiliate, although current percentage ownership has not been publicly disclosed.

afterImage.name: Northstar New Jersey Lottery Group, LLC
afterImage.description: Northstar New Jersey Lottery Group, LLC operates marketing, sales, retailer support, games and systems services for the New Jersey Lottery under a long-term public-service agreement that began in 2013 and expires June 30, 2029. Brightstar owns an effective 65.304% through Northstar New Jersey Holding Company, Scientific Games New Jersey holds 28% under a Brookfield-sponsored ownership group, and OMERS retains the residual HoldCo interest. The exact current OMERS nominee and direct percentage are not separately disclosed; 6.696% is the mathematically implied residual from audited 2025 ownership data. No later sale, extension, termination or signed pending transaction was identified through September 1, 2026. The New Jersey Lottery remains the state counterparty and regulator rather than an equity owner, and holding companies and service affiliates remain within the single Northstar platform boundary.
